'''Telus Digital''' (stylized '''TELUS Digital''') is a Canadian [[business process outsourcing]] (BPO) and technology company and subsidiary of [[Telus Corporation]]. The company provides services in customer experience management, digital solutions, artificial intelligence (AI) and data, and trust, safety and security.<ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS Corp Company Profile |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/T.TO/profile/ |website=Reuters |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>  

The company, then known as Telus International, began trading on the [[Toronto Stock Exchange]] and [[New York Stock Exchange]] in February 2021 under the ticker symbol TIXT.<ref>{{cite news |title=Spinoff Telus International hits stock exchange in largest tech IPO in TSX history |url=https://vancouver.citynews.ca/2021/02/03/spinoff-telus-international-hits-stock-exchange-in-largest-tech-ipo-in-tsx-history/ |work=CityNews Vancouver |agency=The Canadian Press |date=February 3, 2021 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> In 2025, Telus acquired the remaining shares of Telus Digital and took the company private.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus to buy remaining digital unit stake for $539 million |url=https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/telus-buy-remaining-digital-unit-stake-539-million-2025-09-02/ |work=Reuters |date=September 2, 2025 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

== History ==
[[File:TELUS International Office.jpg|alt=Telus Digital office in Bulgaria|thumb|Telus Digital office in Bulgaria]]
Telus Digital originated from Telus Corporation’s investment in Ambergris Solutions, a Philippines-based [[Business process outsourcing]] (BPO) company, in 2005. Ambergris Solutions later became Telus International.<ref>{{cite web |title=2005 annual report financial review |url=https://assets.ctfassets.net/fltupc9ltp8m/7jSM5OXwv6qiCcGwW8KiAA/ea9b6f3411e7c30c074edf1998c2c509/2005_Annual_Report_Financial_Review.pdf |website=Telus |date=2006 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2008, the company acquired Transactel, adding operations in Guatemala and El Salvador.<ref>{{cite web |title=Telus International Looks to Capitalize on Strong BPO Performance in Latin America |url=https://nearshoreamericas.com/telus-latin-america-bpo-performance/ |website=Nearshore Americas |date=August 15, 2012 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2012, Telus International acquired a stake in CallPoint New Europe, which operated delivery centres in Bulgaria and Romania.<ref>{{cite news |title=TELUS Intl buys into Bulgarian-based CallPoint New Europe, EBRD cashes out |url=https://seenews.com/news/telus-intl-buys-into-bulgarian-based-callpoint-new-europe-ebrd-cashes-out-1009616 |work=SeeNews |date=September 20, 2012 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Telus International buys stake in CallPoint New Europe |url=https://business-review.eu/featured/telus-international-buys-stake-in-callpoint-new-europe-32745 |work=Business Review |date=September 24, 2012 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2016, [[Baring Private Equity Asia]] acquired a 35% stake in Telus International, with Telus retaining a 65% interest.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus Sells 35% Stake in Outsourcing Subsidiary to Baring Private Equity Asia |url=https://nearshoreamericas.com/telus-sells-35-stake-in-outsourcing-business/ |work=Nearshore Americas |date=May 6, 2016 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> 

In 2017, Telus International acquired Cork-based Voxpro, a business process outsourcing company, expanding its operations to Ireland.<ref>{{cite news |title=Irish company Voxpro acquired by Telus for estimated €150m |url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/technology/irish-company-voxpro-acquired-by-telus-for-estimated-150m-1.3188658 |work=The Irish Times |date=August 16, 2017 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> 

In 2018, Telus International acquired a majority interest in Xavient Digital, a software and IT services company, expanding its operations in India.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus International acquires IT company Xavient Information Systems |url=https://mobilesyrup.com/2018/02/08/telus-international-acquires-xavient-information-systems/ |work=MobileSyrup |date=February 8, 2018 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> In 2019, Telus International acquired the remaining interest in Voxpro.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus buys rest of Voxpro as Dan Kiely steps down as CEO |url=https://www.irishtimes.com/business/technology/telus-buys-rest-of-voxpro-as-dan-kiely-steps-down-as-ceo-1.4102089 |work=The Irish Times |date=December 2, 2019 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2020, Telus International acquired Competence Call Center, an Austria-based customer relationship management and outsourcing company with operations across Europe.<ref>{{cite web |title=Telus International Snaps up European BPO Rival Competence Call Center |url=https://nearshoreamericas.com/telus-international-snaps-up-european-bpo-rival-competence-call-center/ |website=Nearshore Americas |date=December 9, 2019 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS Corporation Management's discussion and analysis |url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/868675/000110465921020240/tm2038003d1_ex99-2.htm |website=U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission |date=2021 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> In late 2020, Telus announced that Telus International would acquire [[Lionbridge]] AI for US$935 million. Reuters reported that Lionbridge AI provided data labeling and annotation services used to develop artificial intelligence models.<ref>{{cite news |title=Canada's Telus to acquire Lionbridge AI in $935 mln deal |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/canadas-telus-acquire-lionbridge-ai-935-mln-deal-2020-11-06/ |work=Reuters |date=November 6, 2020 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> 

Telus International became a publicly traded company in February 2021, listing on the [[Toronto Stock Exchange|Toronto]] and [[New York Stock Exchange|New York]] stock exchanges under the ticker TIXT.<ref>{{cite news |title=Spinoff Telus International hits stock exchange in largest tech IPO in TSX history |url=https://toronto.citynews.ca/2021/02/03/spinoff-telus-international-hits-stock-exchange-in-largest-tech-ipo-in-tsx-history/ |work=CityNews Toronto |agency=The Canadian Press |date=February 3, 2021 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> In 2021 the company also acquired Playment, a Bengaluru-based data annotation company.<ref>{{cite news |title=Indian Data Annotation Startup Playment Acquired By TELUS International |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/indian-data-annotation-startup-playment-acquired-by-telus-international/ |work=Inc42 |date=July 6, 2021 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2023, Telus International acquired U.S.-based digital product consultancy WillowTree for approximately US$1.2 billion.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus to acquire product development shop WillowTree for $1.2 billion USD |url=https://betakit.com/telus-to-acquire-product-development-shop-willowtree-for-1-2-billion-usd/ |work=BetaKit |date=October 27, 2022 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Telus International acquiring U.S.-based mobile app company for US$1-billion |url=https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-telus-international-acquiring-us-based-mobile-app-company-for-us1-billion/ |work=The Globe and Mail |date=October 27, 2022 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

In 2024, Telus International announced leadership changes, including the retirement of CEO Jeff Puritt as president and chief executive officer and the appointment of Jason Macdonnell as acting chief executive officer.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus contends with tough competition, Telus International challenges in Q2 |url=https://www.stalbertgazette.com/national-business/telus-contends-with-tough-competition-telus-international-challenges-in-q2-9303930 |work=St. Albert Gazette |agency=The Canadian Press |date=August 2, 2024 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> The company rebranded from Telus International to Telus Digital later that year.<ref>{{cite news |title=Beyond the rebrand: TELUS Digital’s next chapter |url=https://www.fastcompany.com/91193150/beyond-the-rebrand-telus-digitals-next-chapter |work=Fast Company |date=2024 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> 

In 2025, Telus Digital acquired Gerent, a U.S.-based Salesforce consultancy firm.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus Digital acquires Salesforce consultancy Gerent |url=https://www.consulting.us/news/12615/telus-digital-acquires-salesforce-consultancy-gerent |work=Consulting.us |date=May 28, 2025 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> Later that year, Telus agreed to acquire the remaining shares of TELUS Digital that it did not already own in a US$539 million cash-and-stock transaction.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus to buy remaining digital unit stake for $539 million |url=https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/telus-buy-remaining-digital-unit-stake-539-million-2025-09-02/ |work=Reuters |date=September 2, 2025 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref> The transaction closed on October 31, 2025, making Telus Digital wholly owned by Telus Corporation.<ref>{{cite news |title=Telus completes Digital takeover |url=https://www.mobileworldlive.com/ai-cloud/telus-completes-digital-takeover/ |work=Mobile World Live |date=October 31, 2025 |access-date=April 22, 2026}}</ref>

== Services ==
Telus Digital’s enterprise services in customer experience management include outsourced customer support and digital experience operations, as well as consulting and transformation services related to customer experience and digital strategy.<ref>{{cite web |title=Customer experience BPO trends, predictions, and providers |url=https://www.cxtoday.com/contact-center/customer-experience-bpos-trends-predictions-providers/ |website=CX Today |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS Corp Company Profile |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/T.TO/ |website=Reuters |access-date=April 9, 2026}}</ref>

The company’s digital and technology services include digital product development capabilities, which were expanded through its acquisition of WillowTree.<ref>{{cite web |title=Telus to acquire product development shop WillowTree for $1.2 billion USD |url=https://betakit.com/telus-to-acquire-product-development-shop-willowtree-for-1-2-billion-usd/ |website=BetaKit |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref>

Its artificial intelligence and data services include data annotation, AI training data development, and analytics supporting machine learning systems.<ref>{{cite web |title=The top five data labeling firms according to Everest Group |url=https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2024/04/23/the-top-five-data-labeling-firms-according-to-everest-group/ |website=HPCwire |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref>

The company has also been associated with AI-driven customer experience solutions and integrations with cloud-based contact center technologies.<ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS uses Amazon Connect to build GenAI-powered asynchronous messaging tool |url=https://www.cxtoday.com/contact-center/telus-uses-amazon-connect-to-build-genai-powered-asynchronous-messaging-tool/ |website=CX Today |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref>

Telus Digital has participated in initiatives related to responsible artificial intelligence development, including adoption of Canada’s voluntary AI code of conduct.<ref>{{cite web |title=Even more organizations adopting Canada’s voluntary code of conduct on artificial intelligence development |url=https://www.canada.ca/en/innovation-science-economic-development/news/2024/11/even-more-organizations-adopting-canadas-voluntary-code-of-conduct-on-artificial-intelligence-development.html |website=Government of Canada |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref>

Analyst coverage has evaluated Telus Digital in areas including customer experience services transformation, conversational commerce and industry-specific CX operations.<ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS Digital – CX Services Transformation |url=https://reimagine.nelson-hall.com/reports/telus-digital-cx-services-transformation |website=NelsonHall |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=TELUS Digital – Conversational Commerce |url=https://reimagine.nelson-hall.com/reports/telus-digital-conversational-commerce |website=NelsonHall |access-date=April 10, 2026}}</ref>

== 2026 1 petabyte cybersecurity incident ==
In March 2026, a notorious cyber crime group known as [[ShinyHunters]] claimed to  several high-profile news agencies that they stole over 1 petabyte (PB) of data from Telus and Telus Digital. The group demanded a staggering $65 million dollar ransom in exchange for not leaking the company's data. The stolen data according to multiple prominent media outlets like [[Reuters]] and [[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]] included ‌information ⁠related to more than two dozen companies that included personally identifiable information, call data and recordings (CDRs), FBI background check information, financial information, [[Salesforce]] data, and source code spanning multiple business divisions within the business services and telecommunications company. The stolen data also reportedly impacts [[Telus Communications|Telus' telecommunication]] services; customers and call logs.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Abrams |first=Lawrence |title=Telus Digital confirms breach after hacker claims 1 petabyte data theft |url=https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/telus-digital-confirms-breach-after-hacker-claims-1-petabyte-data-theft/ |access-date=2026-04-04 |website=BleepingComputer |language=en-us}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Murphy |first=Margi |date=March 12, 2026 |title=Canadian Telecom Telus Says It’s Investigating Cyber Breach |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-03-12/canadian-telecom-telus-says-it-s-investigating-cyber-breach |work=Bloomberg}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Vicens |first=AJ |date=March 12, 2026 |title=Telus says it is investigating hack of its systems |url=https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/telus-says-it-is-investigating-hack-its-systems-2026-03-12/ |work=Reuters}}</ref>
